_what: M0c Session N Probe 1 -- THE NARROWING. Can the 30->10 cut stop dropping gold without paying more in distractors than it recovers?
_diagnosis_already_published: tools/narrow_census.py + narrow_loss_cue_ranks.py over committed dumps: held-out loses 5 cases at narrowing (L2-ranks 11,11,14,17,20; cue-ranks 15,15,2,10,16); fit loses 1 (L2-18, cue-7). Diagnostic only; no arm was scored before this file.

PRIMARY_union_narrow.definition: narrowed = (L-2 top-10 of slate) UNION (cue-key top-10 of slate); fuse = RRF k=60 over (L-2 logit rank within union, L-6 logit rank within union); admit top-3. Everything else identical.
PRIMARY_union_narrow.why_primary: recovers the cue-strong family directly (held-out cue-ranks 2 and 10); the union rule is the one rule-family with precedent in this project's history; no numeric knob.
PRIMARY_union_narrow.cost_risk: union size ~12-16 adds distractors to the fuse for most queries.

SECONDARY_rrf_narrow.definition: rank the slate by RRF k=60 over (L-2 logit rank, cue-key rank); take the top 10 AS the narrowed set; stage 2 unchanged. Width stays exactly 10.
SECONDARY_rrf_narrow.why_registered: parameter-free AND width-preserving -- zero added fuse cost by construction; the honest rival to the union.
SECONDARY_rrf_narrow.cost_risk: may recover fewer cases than the union (deep L2 misses with middling cue rank stay out).

instrument_gate: the probe first re-scores the CURRENT narrowed tens with L-6 through the offline loader and must reproduce the binary's fusion_rank ORDER on 229/229 fit queries (provider may be CUDA; order must match case-for-case). If not, nothing downstream means anything.

primary_union_fit.post_narrow_recall: 225 or 226 of 229 (the known fit loss e8a79c70 is recovered; nothing else should newly arrive)
primary_union_fit.R@3: 211 to 216 (base 213): recovery +1, distractor cost bounded by -2
primary_union_fit.kill: fit R@3 <= 212 OR post-narrow recall fails to rise

what_would_earn_a_heldout_read: an arm whose fit R@3 >= 214 AND post-narrow recall rises, with the distractor cost visible and bounded. Held-out has 5 narrowing losses (3 union-recoverable) so the upside there is up to +3 cases; the read is spent ONCE on the single better arm by the pre-written tie-break: higher fit R@3, ties broken by smaller mean union size (less added latency).
what_will_not_be_done: no width knob (12, 15, 20) -- registering one after seeing these diagnostics would be fitting the cut to the losses
no change to slate depth, RRF k, or admit
latency_note: union widens the fuse forward by ~4 rows on CUDA (~1 ms); CPU deployments never run the cascade.
